events.text: The shop opens: every order becomes an order machine.
SO-10482: a desk lamp, cables and a chair; the bank asks for 3-D Secure.
SO-10483: a small order whose card is declined three times.
SO-10485: two big TVs on a first order: fraud screening rejects it.
SO-10486: a gold customer's headset; she changes the delivery address on the way.
SO-10484: the customer cancels while the warehouse is picking: the payment is refunded.
SO-10487: a reviewer approves the flagged order.
